test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 16 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following cubes can be formed on folding the given sheet of paper in the question?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6376d959901db53ddebff08c29d866d9b144ed2da4ce445d5eb792c338503674.png]
solution:
From the given open Dice:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6befacf1e6bc86756f38089e50508f32ab2be05800178035fd9a12d9d84c79c4.png] 

Z and W is the opposite sides.

X and P is the opposite sides.

Y and R is the opposite sides.

And, two opposite sides can not be the adjacent surfaces, so it can't be shows in a dice.

Now,

Option 1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8fb77b8254f169063ff6493d7e7a368b34fe10b9b407acefadd922458a108280.png] → Can not be made, because Z and W is the opposite sides.

**Option 2)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc922aa52c83b17f48ea89953e4e0d399d1f63a9bd04446ffa6d762fc7b93fa9.png] → Can be made, because all the surfaces are adjacent sides.

Option 3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37777d72962ab7fd0b39031e9a332c1250a0974dd27c0759007f802f07e04fd0.png] → Can not be made, because X and P is the opposite sides.

Option 4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/962dd27c922a571eca5404e331535cdfd19c02acbba652d1d4bedca32d64efdd.png] → Can not be made, because Y and R is the opposite sides.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
